collection.description: A red coral colony would make magnificent beads, but taking it may destroy years of growth.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A red coral colony would make magnificent beads, but removing it may destroy years of growth.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The pieces are too small for the planned necklace; the jeweler makes delicate earrings instead.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The necklace succeeds, though mining the stone creates another resource dilemma.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The artisan learns to value restraint and later teaches reef ecology to apprentices.
